summary: A caller-chosen bucketing key that helps OpenAI route similar requests to the same cache. Replaces the deprecated `user` field for this purpose.
combines: Cached input tokens bill at roughly 10% of normal input rates on gpt-5.6-sol, so a stable key on a stable prefix is a large cost lever.
Requires a genuinely shared prefix (system prompt, tool definitions) to help; a per-request unique key does nothing.
